feeds.title: Foreign Investment and National Security Blog
feeds.description: A growing number of jurisdictions have now introduced national laws enabling the screening and review of incoming foreign investments, often with a focus on specific sectors perceived to be particularly sensitive. This blog aims to provide you with the latest news and updates in respect of foreign investment review and national security trends and developments, keeping you up-to-date and informed about the legal and business risks impacting your next transaction.
